units: <cite ref="Ketubot 50a:9">Keth. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>דטרקא ליה ע׳</he> whom a scorpion stung.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 67b:19">Snh. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>שדא … הוו ע׳</he> he poured out a little (of the water), and scorpions appeared.
